chapter.title: The Yellow Line
chapter.subtitle: Dorothy follows a vanished bus route into a city built on promises.
chapter.description: Dorothy follows a vanished bus route into a city built on promises.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: I took the last bus. Now we’re airborne, the transfer says EMERALD, and this man is shedding hay into the fare box.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: Keep your voice down. They don’t know I’m covering a shift.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: The bus is in a cloud.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: And yet everybody still wants a stop request.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: Wind took the route map. I kept the stop notes. Before you ask: no, I cannot eat them and remember.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: Nobody asked that.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: Last passenger did. Loud, too.

puzzle.title: Six stops and a wet transfer
puzzle.instruction: Rebuild the route from shelter to terminal. Each sign gives stops remaining AFTER that stop. One sign lost its number, so use the transfer note. Visit every stop once.

pieces.label: Lion square
pieces.detail: Between bridge and depot, with neither stop skipped.

pieces.label: Straw market
pieces.detail: My missing number is one less than the shelter’s.

pieces.label: Emerald Terminal
pieces.detail: No stops remain. Transfers home are processed here.

hints: Work backward from zero, then fill the missing number.
Shelter is first, market second; square must be after bridge and before depot.
puzzle.solvedText: Route restored. The return transfer points to Emerald. Oz controls the terminal—not the weather, whatever his billboard says.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: Oz says I need a brain certificate before I can drive the return route. Three favors and a processing fee.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: You just rebuilt the route from six wet scraps.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: He said practical experience doesn’t count.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: He charging you to believe your own head. That is nasty work.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
preDialogue.text: Oz replaced my bridge controls with a sponsored battle kiosk. Winner opens the service lane. I built this bridge and now I need a promo code.

preDialogue.speaker: Dorothy
preDialogue.text: Who puts a leaderboard on a bridge?

preDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
preDialogue.text: A man who never carries groceries.

postDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
postDialogue.text: Service lane’s open. I can get at the control box now.

postDialogue.speaker: Scarecrow
postDialogue.text: You stayed out here all storm?

postDialogue.speaker: Tin Man
postDialogue.text: Somebody had to keep folks off the broken section. Also, I rusted to the railing.

passive.name: The Copper Bridge
passive.description: Control two districts when the final round ends.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Oz says he can install a heart. Premium plan includes empathy.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: You lent your coat to three strangers.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: I want it back. One of them got mustard on the lining.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: You can care and want your coat.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: I was supposed to guard the depot. Then a pigeon made eye contact and I reassessed my calling.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: You still warned everybody about the railing.

scenes.speaker: Lion
scenes.text: From a safe distance. In a voice I do not wish to discuss.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Warning worked. Pigeon still unemployed.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Five operations. One battery. If the tram leaves before the brake test, we all become a cautionary mural.

scenes.speaker: Scarecrow
scenes.text: The scratched labels tell us what needs power and what has to happen before boarding.

puzzle.title: One battery, no second chances
puzzle.instruction: Arrange all five bridge operations. The battery is connected once and stays on. Use the interlocks printed on the controls; an unsafe operation cannot be undone.

pieces.label: Connect power
pieces.detail: No prerequisite. Every other control needs power.

pieces.label: Depart
pieces.detail: Requires the loaded brake test to pass; nobody boards after departure.

pieces.label: Raise the gate
pieces.detail: Only after road traffic stops. Boarding through a closed gate is impossible.

pieces.label: Stop road traffic
pieces.detail: Must happen before the gate rises. Cannot be done once passengers start boarding.

pieces.label: Board and test brakes
pieces.detail: Passengers board through the raised gate. With their weight aboard, perform the stationary brake test.

hints: Find the operation that is possible with a dead battery.
Road traffic must stop before the gate; boarding and brake test come before departure.
puzzle.solvedText: The loaded brakes hold. Tin Man removes the sponsored kiosk from the service controls before anyone can sell the bridge again.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Lion
preDialogue.text: Depot manager sold the last departure slot twice. Posted rule says a match settles the slot. I’m shaking, but I brought my deck.

preDialogue.speaker: Dorothy
preDialogue.text: Round three cuts one Motion from both crews. Save enough to finish.

postDialogue.speaker: Lion
postDialogue.text: Did we win? I blinked with my whole body.

postDialogue.speaker: Scarecrow
postDialogue.text: Next stop: Emerald Terminal. Please have your fare and your unresolved issues ready.

passive.name: Last Tram Through the Poppies
passive.description: Both sides receive 1 less Motion in round three.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: WELCOME TO EMERALD. YOUR POTENTIAL, NOW AVAILABLE IN THREE PAYMENT TIERS.

scenes.speaker: Dorothy
scenes.text: I need a ride home. Not a subscription to myself.

scenes.speaker: Oz
scenes.text: We call that the Journey package.

scenes.speaker: Tin Man
scenes.text: Of course you do.
